title_ru: Осирис — матрица кому выгодно сорвать восстановление
research_question: Кому в source-bound мифологическом графе было бы выгодно сорвать восстановление Осириса одной недостающей деталью, не превращая мотив или доступ в доказательство вины?
core_rule: MOTIVE != GUILT; OPPORTUNITY != CUSTODY; CUSTODY != SABOTAGE

priority_summary.basis: UCL synthesis: Seth murders/dismembers Osiris and takes his place; Book of the Dead 17 encodes direct Horus/Seth opposition and adversarial Seth passages.
priority_summary.not_established: No source currently proves Seth hid the phallus in a specific container.

priority_summary.basis: Book of the Dead 17 explicitly names confederates of Seth in an enemy-repulsion context.
Book of the Dead 151 has Duamutef state that he came to rescue Osiris from his assailant.
priority_summary.not_established: The passage does not independently identify that assailant as Seth.

priority_summary.basis: Book of the Dead 1 preserves enemies of Osiris and those who rebel against him.
priority_summary.not_established: Generic enemy language cannot identify a specific custodian or saboteur.

priority_summary.basis: Generated by the unresolved handoff between recovery and protected embalming/custody domains.
priority_summary.not_established: No named ancient actor currently occupies this role.

negative_controls.ANUBIS: High access, but current source evidence points to embalming/guard/protection, not sabotage.
negative_controls.QEBEHSENUEF: Book of the Dead 151 explicitly reassembles Osiris's bones/limbs and restores the heart.
negative_controls.DUAMUTEF: Book of the Dead 151 explicitly rescues Osiris from his assailant.
negative_controls.ISIS_AND_NEPHTHYS: Restoration/protection alignment; not a current sabotage branch.
negative_controls.HORUS: Succession beneficiary of Osiris; anti-restoration motive is weak in the current corpus.
negative_controls.SOBEK: Existing source-bound pass supports recovery competence and does not establish phallus-specific failure or betrayal.

strongest_new_semantic_clue.paraphrase: Horus's honour and Seth's binding are presented in a vice-versa opposition.
strongest_new_semantic_clue.interpretation: Within the source graph, Seth's political/cosmic incentive is unusually explicit: strengthening the Osiris-Horus succession weakens Seth's position.
strongest_new_semantic_clue.claim_ceiling: This is a motive relation, not proof of a specific concealment event.

investigative_model.protector_path: DUAMUTEF / QEBEHSENUEF -> ANUBIS -> EMBALMING / PROTECTION -> CHEST / SHRINE / RELIQUARY
investigative_model.target_intersection: Find the first source-bound handoff from an adversarial domain into a protected custody domain without assuming the protector caused the concealment.

search_order: identify last source-bound adversarial actor before restoration
identify first protective custodian after restoration begins
identify any container/substitution/relic-simulacrum node between them
separate deliberate concealment from protective concealment
map resulting object class to museum X-ray/CT/conservation records
next_gate.museum_priority: Objects where Seth/Seth-confederate iconography or provenance intersects later Osirian/Anubian protective container contexts; do not infer guilt from co-occurrence alone.
